{{Quote|I am ''Kanto Raka'', independent thief and brigand-for-hire. I've come to make a sizeable ''withdrawal'' from the casino's vault.|Kanto Raka|<ref name="The Professional!">{{TCWComicCite|6.12|The Professional!}}</ref>}}
'''Kanto Raka''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] professional [[Thief/Legends|thief]]. He encountered [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], while they were on a [[Mission to Katalla|mission]] to blow up the vault on the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katalla]]. They succeeded, and Raka took some of the vault's contents for himself.
